title: Document care
headline: Careful sharing starts here.
description: Your documents contain sensitive information. Begin with a description rather than a file.

sections.title: What to tell us first
sections.text: Document category, destination, purpose and the issue in general terms. Avoid full names, identity numbers, exact birth dates and private case references until there is a clear need.

sections.title: What never belongs in a chat request
sections.text: Do not share passwords, one-time codes or a request to bypass applicant consent. Use the official platform directly for steps that require your identity.

sections.title: Before transferring files
sections.text: Confirm the person handling the file, purpose, access, transfer method, retention and deletion arrangements. This website accepts no document uploads and does not claim a secure-storage service.

sections.title: Correcting records
sections.text: Changes to an official record must go through its issuer. Never erase, overwrite or digitally change an official document yourself.
